_comment: Example only. Copy to config/search.json (gitignored) and edit, or let /setup write it. Apply it to the database with: scripts/jobsearch search-profile apply. These are the free rule filters that run BEFORE any AI is called. Every source is one switch: its name in "sources". Names: indeed, naukri, linkedin, linkedin_apify (paid: uses Apify credit), glassdoor, ziprecruiter, google; company boards greenhouse, lever, ashby, workable, smartrecruiters (each also needs company slugs under "boards"); remote feeds remotive, remoteok, weworkremotely, himalayas, arbeitnow. Change them with: scripts/jobsearch sources (on|off|only NAMES). "boards" looks like {"greenhouse": ["stripe"], "ashby": [{"slug": "openai", "name": "OpenAI"}]}; find a slug with: scripts/jobsearch boards find NAME. "board_title_words" are extra words that qualify a company-board or feed job title on their own (for example "software"). See docs/sources.md.
